messages:
maya: Orpheus9b landed into the infra bench. Quick ask — int8 vs int4 guidance for GTN/product please. int8 looks cheaper than fp16, int4 is even cheaper but we saw a hit on long-form recall in initial evals. Need a short recommendation and a routing flag suggestion.

diego: Pulled the numbers from the smoke runs this morning: p95 latency int8 = 120ms, int4 = 110ms. Throughput a touch higher on int4. Rough normalized unit cost we used: int8 $0.0009/token, int4 $0.0006/token (includes batching/caching assumptions).

lina-qa: Quick eval note: on our 5k long-form QA slice exact-match drops ~6.4% when fully int4 vs int8. For short 0-3 shot completions diff is <1%. Hallucination rate +2.1ppt on int4 for long prompts.

sam: My pragmatic take for GTN: default to int8 (safety/consistency), expose opt-in short-prompt int4 path for low-cost flows. Canary int4 at 5% across targeted slices (search summarization, trivial completions).

aj: +1. Also recommend enabling KV-cache warmstarts for priming-heavy routes — that recovers both latency and token cost for long prompts and reduces priming delta between quant levels.

maya: Can someone sketch a routing config we can hand to infra + PMs as a flag? Keep it minimal so infra can feature-flag it.

diego: Quick config snippet (proto, not production):

```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"name":"short_prompts","match":"tokens<=64 && metadata.intent=='assistant'","model":"orpheus9b-int4","split":0.05},
    {"name":"default","model":"orpheus9b-int8","split":0.95}
  ],
  "fallbacks":[{"from":"orpheus9b-int4","to":"orpheus9b-int8","on":["quality_drop","timeout"]}]
}
```

maya: Nice. ops-bot, any constraints for doing a canary deploy to Dedicated pools tomorrow?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy to eng-dedicated-orpheus tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Canary window 2h. Auto-rollback triggers: >2% regression on any primary slice metric (exact-match or hallucination) or >20% p95 latency increase.

sam: For GTN blurb I'll draft: "Recommend default int8 with short-prompt int4 opt-in; expected overall cost reduction ~20-25% with <1% impact on core short-prompt UX. Reserve int8 for high-value long-form use cases until we iterate on quantization and adapters."

lina-qa: Test plan for canary: slices = [search summarization (<=64 tokens), multi-turn assistant (history 3), longform QA (>512 tokens)]. Metrics: exact-match, hallucination rate, p95 latency, token-cost delta. Run AB for 24h and produce quick pivot table.

maya: Next steps: sam = GTN blurb + numbers, diego = submit routing flag PR, lina-qa = run overnight slice tests and post signal. I'll monitor canary and call rollback if thresholds hit.

aj: One follow-up idea: if int4 quality gap on longform persists, consider mixed-per-layer 4-bit for middle layers (keep head/top layers int8) — we can experiment on a small variant.

maya: Thanks all :thumbsup: Any other blockers?

lina-qa: I'll post the baseline CSV once tests finish.

diego: I'll prod infra about cache warmstart toggles.

maya: Great — closing this thread for now, ping me with the PR/PR link when ready.
